name: Darkbolts
body:
School evocation [shadow]; Level death mage 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect 1 bolt/ 2 caster levels
Duration instantaneous (see text)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You unleash bolts of pure darkness from your outstretched hand. You must succeed on a ranged touch to affect a target. Each bolt may be at a different target and the targets must be living creatures.

Each creature hit takes 2d8 negative energy damage and must make a Will save or be dazed for 1 round. The dazing does not stack from multiple hits.

The bolts may be fired all at once or one per round as a free action. If a bolt is not launched in a particular round, it is lost. If the bolts are launched all at once, the targets must all be within 30 feet of each other.
